source_caption:
📺 Gilmore Girls (2000–2007)

Gilmore Girls follows Lorelai Gilmore, a witty and independent single mother, and her teenage daughter Rory as they navigate love, friendship, family relationships, and everyday life in the charming town of Stars Hollow, Connecticut. After becoming a mother at sixteen, Lorelai builds a life for herself while trying to give Rory opportunities she never had. As Rory pursues her dreams of attending prestigious schools and becoming a journalist, she experiences complicated romances, friendships, heartbreak, and the challenges of growing up. Meanwhile, Lorelai balances her career, romantic relationships, and difficult relationship with her wealthy parents, Emily and Richard. Surrounded by unforgettable characters, including Luke Danes, Sookie St. James, Lane Kim, and Paris Geller, the series delivers hilarious conversations, emotional moments, memorable love stories, and heartwarming family experiences. Starring Lauren Graham and Alexis Bledel, the show celebrates motherhood, ambition, friendship, and the extraordinary bond between a mother and daughter.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Romance • Family

⭐ IMDb: 8.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 44 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Amy Sherman-Palladino

📺 Seasons: 7 • 153 Episodes

📚 Follow-Up Series: Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life (2016)

🏆 Awards: Winner of a Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Makeup for a Series.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix (United States)

source_details.synopsis: Gilmore Girls is an American comedy drama television series created by Amy Sherman-Palladino. It stars Lauren Graham and Alexis Bledel as Lorelai and Rory Gilmore, a mother–daughter pair living in the fictional town of Stars Hollow, Connecticut. The series also stars an ensemble supporting cast, including Melissa McCarthy, Keiko Agena, Yanic Truesdale, Scott Patterson, Kelly Bishop, Edward Herrmann, Liza Weil, Jared Padalecki, Milo Ventimiglia, Sean Gunn, Chris Eigeman, and Matt Czuchry. It premiered on The WB on October 5, 2000, and ran for seven seasons, concluding on The CW on May 15, 2007.
